subject: Reinitialize pointer 'p' after ziplistDeleteRange to fix head deletion bug (#537)
reason: The change touches only src/unit/test_ziplist.c: it fixes a stale pointer in the unit test test_ziplistDeleteInclusiveRange0To0 by reinitializing 'p' via ziplistIndex after ziplistDeleteRange. No server source changes — ziplistDeleteRange itself is unmodified — so no command reply, data structure, replication, or persistence behavior differs between the builds. A test-only fix is unreachable by any runtime scenario and needs none.
